meta.description: Infostream builds and runs the systems behind Montenegro's public finance — tax administration, treasury budgets, business and pension registers — audited to ISO 27001 and ISO 9001, in production for over 20 years.

hero.title: Building software that keeps business moving.
hero.body: For two decades, we've designed, built and operated software that organisations rely on every day. From enterprise platforms to cloud and AI solutions, we deliver technology that evolves with your business.
hero.exitAccent: Twenty years of staying on the line.

services.title: We build the systems a state runs on.
services.body: Since 2004 we have designed, built and run public-finance systems and national registers — five disciplines, delivered end to end and kept entirely in house.

items.v: Custom treasury, budgeting, payments and statutory reporting — built to fit how each institution operates, then run in production for the long term.
Authoritative national registers at the close of administrative procedure: we built the Central Register of Business Entities and the Digital Address Register.
We move institutions off paper: unstructured documents are captured, digitised and centralised, so information stays secure and instantly available.
We match the right technology to each need, then deliver it as a flexible platform that holds steady under real production load.
We help clients weigh their options and apply technology that genuinely reshapes how they work — practical decisions, not novelty.

platform.title: Four stages. One accountable team.
platform.body: Every engagement runs through the same four stages — no handoffs to subcontractors, no surprises after sign-off.

stages.name: Discovery
stages.description: Every successful project starts with a shared understanding. Through Agile workshops and continuous collaboration, we align business objectives, technical requirements and delivery expectations from day one.
stages.agile: We adapt to change without losing sight of the goals that matter.

stages.name: Architecture
stages.description: Data models, integrations, security boundaries and failure modes are drawn out and signed off — not invented mid-build.

intro.v: A structured approach to designing resilient, secure and future-ready solutions.

stages.tag: Architecture is where strategy becomes structure.

cards.v: We understand your business goals and define the right architecture strategy.
We create a solution architecture that is scalable, secure and efficient.
We verify integrations, security and performance to ensure reliability.
We hand over a clear, validated blueprint ready for agile delivery.

stages.agile: We design for change, not just for delivery.

stages.name: Build
stages.description: Working software is delivered in increments, allowing feedback, adaptation and measurable progress throughout the project.

support.v: Continuous testing ensures reliability and high standards.
Stakeholder feedback drives better solutions and outcomes.
Incremental releases provide value early and reduce project risk.

stages.agile: Working software is delivered early and improved continuously through feedback and iteration.

stages.name: Operate
stages.description: Go-live is not the finish line. We monitor, support and continuously improve solutions to ensure long-term business value.

support.v: Dedicated assistance when you need it.

stages.agile: Feedback does not stop at delivery. Every release creates new opportunities for improvement.

clients.title: We do not have many clients. We have the right ones.

projects.title: Systems we've shipped.
projects.body: A few of the systems and tools we've built and run in production — most of them powering Montenegro's public institutions.

items.name: Official Gazette — Legal Register
items.summary: Register of the refined, consolidated texts of Montenegro's laws and regulations for the Official Gazette — full-text search across every published act.

items.name: DotBond
items.summary: An open-source toolchain our engineers built to generate fully-typed TypeScript clients from C#/.NET back-ends — keeping front-end and API contracts in lockstep.

items.name: Regulations Register
items.summary: Back-office register for classifying and publishing national regulations — issuer workflows, regulation metadata and EU-harmonisation chapter tracking.

items.name: Innovation Fund Platform
items.summary: The information system behind the Innovation Fund of Montenegro — managing funding programmes and applications, searchable by programme and year.

items.name: Register of NGOs & Political Parties
items.summary: Online registration and records for Montenegro's NGOs and political parties at ngo.gov.me — guided submission, seat and membership data, document issuance.

security.title: Built to be audited.
security.body: Two parallel ISO regimes, Bitdefender enterprise across endpoints and servers, an internal red team that breaks our own code before anyone else can.

pillars.v: Information security management, certified and externally audited annually.
Quality management across the full delivery lifecycle.
Enterprise endpoint and server protection across all production estate.

contact.title: If you run something critical, we should talk.
contact.body: We reply to enquiries within one business day.

technology.title: The stack underneath.
technology.body: Stable, well-understood tooling — chosen for longevity, audit-trail and operational predictability over novelty.

tiers.label: Core Platform
tiers.note: Oracle at the core for transactional integrity, PL/SQL and point-in-time recovery — with PostGIS for spatial data and Elasticsearch for full-text search.

tiers.label: Application
tiers.note: Server-side logic and operator-facing web interfaces, built as microservices and shipped through continuous integration and automated testing.

tiers.label: Security
tiers.note: Endpoint and server protection across the production estate, under externally audited control regimes.
